domain-information: A Sales Consultant greets customers and shows them vehicles that match their preferences
A Sales Consultant arranges test drives and collects feedback to help the customer decide
A Finance Officer reviews customer credit applications and offers financing options for car purchases
A Finance Officer prepares loan or lease agreements to complete the sale
An Inventory Manager tracks the vehicles on the lot and updates availability records for the sales team
An Inventory Manager orders new cars from manufacturers to keep popular models in stock
A Customer browses available cars online and visits the dealership to compare models
A Customer negotiates trade-ins or purchases to complete their vehicle acquisition

domain objects.name: Sales Consultant
domain objects.description: Employee who guides customers through selecting and evaluating vehicles

domain objects.name: Vehicle
domain objects.description: Car available for viewing, test driving, or purchase

domain objects.name: Test Drive
domain objects.description: Customer trial of a vehicle before deciding on a purchase

domain objects.name: Customer
domain objects.description: Person interested in browsing, evaluating, or purchasing a vehicle

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: Customer impressions about a vehicle or test drive

domain objects.name: Finance Officer
domain objects.description: Staff member who reviews financing eligibility and prepares agreements

domain objects.name: Credit Application
domain objects.description: Customer submission used to evaluate financing options

domain objects.name: Car Purchase
domain objects.description: Transaction record for buying a vehicle including financing details

domain objects.name: Financing Option
domain objects.description: Proposed loan terms available to a customer

domain objects.name: Lease Agreement
domain objects.description: Contract outlining terms for leasing a vehicle

domain objects.name: Inventory Manager
domain objects.description: Employee who tracks vehicle availability and manages stock levels

domain objects.name: Manufacturing Order
domain objects.description: Order request for new vehicles sent to a manufacturer

domain objects.name: Manufacturer
domain objects.description: External vehicle producer receiving inventory orders

associations.description: Inventory Manager creates a Manufacturing Order to request new vehicles
Manufacturing Order is sent to the Manufacturer for processing
Inventory Manager tracks each Vehicle in the lot
Customer submits a Credit Application for financing review
Sales Consultant presents a Vehicle to assist customer decisions
Customer participates in a Test Drive to evaluate a vehicle
Test Drive uses a specific Vehicle for evaluation
Sales Consultant arranges the Test Drive for the customer
Customer provides Feedback based on their sales experience
Feedback is directed to the Sales Consultant for service improvement
Customer initiates a Car Purchase to acquire a vehicle
Car Purchase is tied to the Vehicle being bought
Finance Officer prepares documentation for the Car Purchase
Finance Officer evaluates the Credit Application for approval
